summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Volatility Premium Plus ETF (ZVOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in volatility alternatives. The fund is an actively managed fund aiming to provide a monthly income stream and inverse exposure to the daily performance of the S&P 500 VIX Mid-Term Futures Index. The fund holds short positions in fourth, fifth, sixth, and seventh month VIX futures contracts. ZVOL was launched on Apr 19, 2023 and is issued by Volatility Shares.
